independent_integer_boundary_test.scope: Plain module import and scalar integer functions only; no torch model or CUDA execution; no scientific payloads.

integration_requirements: Bind this exact source manifest/review and CPU evidence in combined_v5.
Retain existing original, boundary and resident full numerical qualification/terminal gates; router source review cannot substitute for them.
Record executor.capacity_route_receipt per complete update; keep existing worker,whole-family,layout-cache and actual device reserved-memory guards.

limitations: Capacity inequalities are pre-forward allocation screens, not allocator contiguity or future reserved-peak guarantees.
Tiny CPU parity and prior single full-parent qualifications do not establish all20-parent GPU peaks or bitwise-identical long training trajectories.
No stable speed,accuracy or sustained80 percent useful GPU utilization claim is supported by this router review.

reviewed_CPU_evidence.test_fixture: Three synthetic holds,1600 samples,4815 nodes,one ragged512 partition,6 synthetic focals,64 haplotype GRU tile,1024 history window

route_findings: Only existing upward_direct_resident_CPUcontext512 and explicit_CPUcontext512 factories are selectable. Original model equations, targets, complete two sweeps/history, decoder, FP32,49 parameters and optimizer schedule are unchanged.

Actual N is CPU bank.parent.numel; all per-hold counts, native-hold count,1600 haplotypes and complete metadata sum must agree. Loose all20 upper bounds are planning evidence only and are not used as actual counts.
A temporary governed CPU-layout lease is acquired before the live CUDA snapshot; the chosen original factory takes its own lease and the temporary lease is released in finally on success or failure.

Resident selection requires A+2*N*128+16GiB<=declared soft<=74GiB and2*N*128+16GiB<=driver_free+reserved-A. Current allocations are charged, and reserved-minus-allocated cache capacity is counted once.
When resident does not fit, original explicitCPU512 is selected only if A+16GiB<=soft and16GiB<=driver_free+reserved-A. If baseline scratch fails, reject before either forward.

Invalid/incoherent counters, reduced scratch, alternate context flags, unqualified partitions and non-FP32/non-cuda0 model reject. Existing original constructors retain exact model/bundle types, full-device permission and per-stage capacity guards.
There is no catch-OOM fallback, learned forward retry, allocator flush, precision/target change or optional GPU-context composition. Constructor errors propagate after probe-lease cleanup.

capacity_route_receipt records actual counts,live counters,both margins,selected original factory/reason and pre-forward selection. The integration must save it per update and supply its existing actual-RSS cache admission and resource_check callbacks.
